name: The Silver River, North of Silvermere
desc1: The rippling surface of the river appears to be molten silver,
desc2: shimmering mysteriously in the mist. Occasionally a loud splash can be
desc3: heard, quickly followed by strange shadows moving within the water.
desc4: The river flows very quickly downstream to the west, and is perilous
desc5: to travel even in a good boat, as the watery creatures inhabiting the
desc6: river can often be unfriendly. The city wall of Silvermere stands
desc7: proud to the south, and a dark, forbidding forest lies to the north.
